definitions.gloss: kinpira; stir-fried and simmered root vegetables
definitions.explanation: a Japanese dish of julienned root vegetables (typically burdock and carrot) stir-fried and simmered in soy sauce, sugar, and mirin

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
Named after {坂田金平|さかたきんぴら}, the strongman son of Kintarō in Edo-period puppet plays; the dish's crunch and chili heat were likened to his toughness.

TYPES:
- きんぴらごぼう - burdock and carrot kinpira (most common)
- きんぴられんこん - lotus root kinpira
- きんぴらにんじん - carrot kinpira

CULTURAL NOTE:
A classic home-cooking (⟦{家庭料理|かていりょうり}→家庭料理：17474_kateiryouri⟧) dish, commonly found in bento boxes and as a side dish (⟦{副菜|ふくさい}→副菜：04993_fukusai⟧).
